foundational_paper: Arya, D., Maeda, H., Ghosh, S. K., Toshniwal, D., & Sekimoto, Y. (2022). RDD2022: A multi-national image dataset for automatic Road Damage Detection. IEEE BigData 2022 / Geoscience Data Journal (2024).
purpose: Supplementary training and validation data to resolve D10 (transverse crack) class collapse and improve thin D00 (longitudinal crack) feature sensitivity in VisionGuard AI road defect detector.

quarantine_protocol.quarantined_test_split: RDD2022 India Held-Out Test Set (1,200 images)
quarantine_protocol.sequence_splitting_method: Contiguous sequence blocks of 50 frames with deterministic seed 42
